server_description: Retrieve passages from the publisher's approved documents in the Foundry IQ knowledge base, not the web: the reprint and stock policy, the marketing investment guidelines, the decision authority matrix, the signal glossary, the weekly author sales update template and the author communication tone guide. Call it for what a policy, a threshold, an approval limit, a definition, a template or the tone guide says, with one natural-language question that names what you need, such as who may approve an expedited reprint. Documents set rules and definitions; they never hold current sales, stock, signals or options, which come from the live ontology. Cite each document's title, and its section, such as §3, only when the passage names it, taken from the passage text, and name the document inline in the answer, because the result can omit citation markers. If no passage covers the question, say that no approved document covers it. Read-only.
